title: Luau Beach Party (Fiesta Luau en la Playa)
names_seen: Luau Beach Party (Fiesta Luau en la Playa)

facts.statement: A community luau beach party event was held at Playa Azul, where players gathered to dance, transform into crabs, set off fireworks, trade collections and socialize.
facts.quote: Todo mundo estará llegando a las orillas del mar en Playa Azul para bailar, convertirse en cangrejos

facts.statement: The Americas/Latin America session was Thursday 24 March 2011 at 15:00 PST (23:00 CET) on Server 1.
facts.quote: Jueves 24 de marzo, 2011 15:00hrs. PST (23:00 CET) (EE.UU. y Latino America) Servidor 1

facts.statement: The UK/Europe session was Friday 25 March 2011 at 09:00 PST / 17:00 UTC on Server 1.
facts.quote: viernes 25 de marzo, 2011 09:00hrs. PST / 17:00hrs. UTC (UK y Europa) Servidor 1

facts.statement: Community Ambassadors were present at the event to ask trivia questions, dance on the sea, and answer players' questions about the game.
facts.quote: Nuestros Embajadores de la comunidad estarán presentes para hacer preguntas triviales, bailar sobre el mar

article_summaries.title: Evento Comunitario: Fiesta Luau en la Playa
article_summaries.summary: A Spanish-language community event announcement for a Luau beach party at Playa Azul on Server 1, with two session times for the Americas and for UK/Europe in late March 2011. Community Ambassadors were to host trivia, dancing and Q&A. The page also says outfits can be obtained through quests, web codes, in-game currency, or the Station Cash catalog.
